info.name: Webex Admin Address Book Estimated Wait Time API

params.name: queueId
params.description: Id of the queue for which the EWT is to be returned

params.name: lookbackMinutes
params.description: Integer between 5 and 240 (4 hours) signifying how long back to look at the data points to determine EWT for this queue

params.name: maxCV
params.description: This an optional parameter. Maximum value of Coefficient of Variance in a subset of samples (wait times for tasks that got connected to agent in one minute interval) to determine whether the average of such values should be treated as a valid sample for EWT computation. If its not passed it takes the default value of 40 %

params.name: minValidSamples
params.description: This an optional parameter. Minimum value of percentage of valid samples (with respect to total number of samples) in the specified lookbackMinutes minutes. If its not passed it takes the default value of 40 %

params.name: orgId
params.description: Organization ID to use for this operation. If unspecified, inferred from token. Token must have permission to interact with this organization.

items.docs: Retrieve Estimated Wait Time information for a specified look back interval for a specific orgId and queueId combination, with ability to customomize maxCV and minValidSamples (See description above).
